title: Close Encounters Fishing Charters
specs: Fish species include tarpon, snook, red fish, black drum, cobia, triple tail, sea trout, jack crevalle, shark, king mackerel, barracuda, goliath grouper, largemouth bass, crappie, striped bass, catfish, panfish, gar fish, bowfin, american shad

Fishing locations include Ponce Inlet, Sebastian Inlet, Banana River Lagoon, Mosquito Lagoon, Lake Toho, St Johns River, Butler Chain of Lakes, Conway Chain of Lakes, Johns Lake, Lake Howell, Lake Harris, Lake Apopka
blurb: Guests fish for a wide variety of species including tarpon, snook, red fish, black drum, cobia, and many others in diverse locations such as Ponce Inlet, Sebastian Inlet, Banana River Lagoon, and Mosquito Lagoon. The charters cater to all boating and fishing experience levels and provide quality gear and attentive captains. The goal is to create memorable fishing experiences for all guests.

quotes.text: What a trip! Capt. Xavier found the fish and kept us on them. He also lined up a couple of other guides for our large group and between the three boats, I’m confident we caught over a ton (2,000 lbs) of black drum. Crazy thing is that this was all done in an afternoon trip!! What I thought was going to be beautiful afternoon on the water turned into a fishing trip of a lifetime. One of those trips you’ll never forget. Had we not caught a single fish, I think we would’ve still had a blast with Capt. Xavier. He’s a fun guy to fish with!!

I’ve been on many charters through the years and can say hands-down Captain Xavier is the Best of the best. His fishing knowledge and instinct comes from years of experience that is evident in my photos. If you want to catch fish, Close Encounters is the boat you want to be on!
Great captain. Experienced and top notch equipment. Put us on 25-40 lbs redfish and had a once in a lifetime day. Cannot recommend enough.
